assumptions.choice: Calculated as percentage drop in total portfolio value from the previous bar's closing valuation (self.prev_val - current_val) / self.prev_val >= 0.005.
assumptions.reason: The specification executes on 1-day timeframe bars, making daily capital loss equivalent to bar-over-bar portfolio value loss.

assumptions.choice: Exit order is placed when len(self) - entry_bar >= 3.
assumptions.reason: Spec specifies exit after 3 bars, meaning 3 complete daily bars have elapsed following the bar on which entry filled.

assumptions.choice: Fixed order size of 100 shares per trade.
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'no more than 100 shares per trade'; 100 shares is set directly as trade size.
